</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=6) pg. 71 <sup>2.0</sup>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</row>

</column>

You become a mantis. You gain the effects of [_insect form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=163), heightened to _mantis form’s_ level, and you can only transform into a mantis.
